description_en: Cancels the access of an Express Connect circuit. After the cancellation, the Express Connect circuit enters the Canceled state
description_zh: 取消物理专线接入，取消后物理专线进入Canceled状态
kebab_example: aliyun vpc cancel-physical-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --physical-connection-id pc-119mfjzm70000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CancelPhysicalConnection

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit. 

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。 

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect circuit
parameters.name: physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value. The value must be unique among different requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
